tools.name: search_market
tools.description: Search qualifying AI capabilities across AWS Marketplace and the Official MCP Registry. Returns both sources by default.

tools.name: market_status
tools.description: Return xOmniMarket source population and freshness status.

tools.name: get_market_item
tools.description: Return the rich source-backed xOmniMarket record for one market entity id, including confirmed AWS/MCP presence.

tools.name: compare_market_items
tools.description: Compare two to eight rich xOmniMarket records without inventing cross-source score equivalence.

tools.name: find_alternatives
tools.description: Find evidence-backed similarity alternatives to a rich catalog item. Similarity does not imply product identity or interchangeability.

tools.name: build_decision_report
tools.description: Build a source-backed decision report for one to eight catalog items, including market presence and evidence gaps.

tools.name: market_category_summary
tools.description: Summarize the current bounded xOmniMarket search results for a category or capability query. This is a search-result summary, not an exhaustive market census.
